# Hugo Bottomdown

> **Halfelin spy** d'Etelka Toppenheimer Sudenland. **Incompétent — fixé sur PJ** (canon ch.5 l.11 *« rather incompetent spy »*). Mission : surveiller Castle Reikguard + confirmer mariage Todbringer/Holswig. Carry note Etelka mentionnant **Fione Brecht / Heideinheim** = lien Threshers.

## Identité publique
- **Espèce** : Halfelin.
- **Fonction** : **Spy** for **Etelka Toppenheimer of Sudenland**.
- **Personnalité canon (ch.5 l.13)** : *« rather incompetent spy. She has ordered Hugo to keep an eye on Castle Reikguard, and he is fixated on the Characters »*.
- **Si cornered canon (ch.5 l.17)** : *« becomes indignant. 'Very well, I may have been keeping tabs on you. I act in the interests of a noble elector of our great Empire, and you must let me work unhindered! Now, I will be kind enough to assume that you are not up to anything untoward. You go your way, and I shall go mine.' »*
- **Surprisingly dedicated** si threatened : fights fierce bravery + carries **small vial of poison** to end own life if captured (canon ch.5 l.27).
- **Statut** : [VIVANT — SPY DÉTECTABLE]

## Note canon (handout ch.5 l.20-32)

> **A New Dawn for Solland**
> *Actions required as vital priorities in the service of her majesty:*
>
> 1. *Acquire horse, camping gear, trail rations, spare uniforms.*
> 2. *At Pfiefdorf ask for Fione the Thresher. Give her the uniforms and pay her. The word is Heideinheim.*
> 3. *Travel to the Reikland. Confirm the marriage between the Todbringers and the House of the Third Wilhelm. Record any persons of interest.*
> 4. *Report back before the solstice.*

→ **Lien Threshers + Heideinheim raid** : Hugo doit livrer uniformes Nuln à Brecht à Pfeildorf (Sudenland capital). Word = Heideinheim (= village stage raid).

## Apparitions par session

### Arc 7 ch.5 (S60+)
- **[S?]** — **Spotted following PJ on pony** depuis Castle Reikguard returning Altdorf. Distance.
- **Si Hugo notices spotted** : guides horse into undergrowth. Once thinks coast clear, rides hard catch up + continue shadow.
- **Si cornered + threats** : note drop ou body search if drops.
- **Si capturé + threats death** : poison small vial. *« Never reveals which elector hired him »*.
- **Si laissé go** : resumes following after hour.
